propositions: Negative caplog assertions pass vacuously when zero records are captured, silently reporting green despite verifying nothing
Logger propagation or level changes during a test or import can poison subsequent caplog assertions in the same process, causing them to miss records they should capture

An autouse fixture in the test harness detects when logging.getLogger('rebar').propagate is disabled and fails the test at the source of the mutation, restoring state to prevent cascade onto innocent downstream tests

All five negative caplog assertions in the repo are reachable and live over a full default-selection parallel run, with propagate=True at assertion time; injecting forbidden records makes all five fail

Logger level raised by install_stderr_handler() is contained per-test (snapshot/restore) rather than blamed, because raising level is a legitimate side effect of exercising real entrypoints in-process
